title: Per-country passport-number pattern gazetteer (D-14)
description: Structural patterns (anchored regex + length + alphabet + sample) for the 11 shipping issuers. Promoted verbatim from src/resecta_data/gazetteers/passport_patterns/sources/passport_patterns_candidates.json after the candidates-file review workflow. Cuba (CU) is excluded entirely per F-37 OFAC sanctions posture; Guatemala (GT) is held as a V1.1+ swap candidate. Dominican Republic uses issuer_code DO (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). The shipping row set is closed at the 11 enum values below. Row-level shape and audit-only fields (candidate_only, exclude_from_ship, exclusion_reason, ship_loose_vs_omit_analysis, format_attestation) are stripped by the builder before validation.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

generated_date.description: Deterministic ISO date lifted verbatim from the candidates JSON. Wall-clock content is banned from payloads.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Unused by this builder (deterministic transcription), preserved for uniformity across artifacts.

source_briefs.description: Verbatim from candidates JSON. Each entry names a research brief (e.g. 'W-R-4 (2026-04-22)').

rows.description: Shipping rows in ascending issuer_code order. Fixed at 11 per F-36 scope decision.

issuer_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 restricted to the 11 V1 shipping issuers. Cuba (CU) is omitted per F-37 sanctions posture; Guatemala (GT) is V1.1+ candidate-only.

patterns.description: One or more anchored regex strings describing the passport-number shape. Unions may appear as a single string with alternation or as multiple array elements; preserved verbatim from the candidates file.

length.description: Fixed character length (integer) or a {min,max} range. All 11 V1 rows use an integer; the range variant is reserved for future issuers whose length is published as a band.

alphabet.description: Human description of the character class (e.g. 'numeric', 'alpha-prefixed', 'alpha-numeric').

check_digit_policy.description: All 11 V1 rows use 'none known' per the cross-issuer ICAO Doc 9303 finding that no issuer publishes a book-level check digit (MRZ check-digits are a separate mechanism).

license_posture.description: Per-row legal posture. §105 PD applies to US State Department publications. Gov-work (Feist) covers factual publications by other national governments (format facts are uncopyrightable under Feist v. Rural Tel.). 'needs-legal-review' applies to GB (F-38 OGL v3.0 attribution posture pending Jesse + counsel).

license_notes.description: Prose license rationale, source citations, and any caveats (e.g. the MEDIUM-confidence ceiling note for SV).

source_url.description: Canonical publisher URL for the primary source.

source_verified_date.description: ISO date the source was last verified.

confidence.description: Per-row confidence. SV is capped at 'medium' pending corpus-sample / LAIP / DGME outreach (see post_v1_tasks).

recent_format_changes.description: Format-transition events that sit inside the 10-year valid-passport window. Empty array for issuers with no recent transition.

transition_date.description: Transition date. Usually ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) but may be year-only (e.g. US NGP '2021' had no single cutover date).

post_v1_task.description: Optional single-task follow-up (CN carries an NIA policy-page / production-sentinel note).

post_v1_tasks.description: Optional list of follow-up tasks. SV carries V-ES-1 / V-ES-2 / V-ES-3 per the MEDIUM-confidence ceiling rationale.

ceiling_rationale.description: Optional narrative of the per-row confidence ceiling. Present on SV.

pending_decision_memo.description: Structured hand-off to Jesse + counsel for an F-item pending decision. Present on GB (F-38 OGL attribution A / B / C).
